description: Versioned, labelled local-assistant RAG eval set (specs/rag.md § Evaluation set; data.md Evaluation contract: eval set = RAG). Each case is a question + expected-grounding label. Scored deterministically by tests/spine/test_rag_eval.py against the REAL sentence-transformers embedder (semantic retrieval, offline/vendored) with a stubbed LLM for reproducible generation. Release gate: all cases must pass. Symbolic participant refs (participant_a/participant_b/other_site/none) are resolved against the seeded fixture at run time.

scoring.faithfulness: Pipeline-level + deterministic: an ANSWERED turn must carry >=1 grounding citation; a turn with no retrievable grounding must REFUSE (status=refused). The system never emits an ungrounded answer. (LLM-judged sentence-level entailment needs a judge model and is non-deterministic -> deferred; this proxy verifies grounding presence, which is the faithfulness contract at the boundary.)
scoring.citation_precision: Every citation references an actually-retrieved source (citations are built from retrieval, not from LLM text) -> structurally no fabricated citations.
scoring.citation_recall: For metric/answerable cases, the expected source class (card .md for metrics) is present among citations.
scoring.answerable_vs_unanswerable: An answerable in-corpus question is answered+cited; an unanswerable question with no retrievable grounding yields a grounded refusal (status=refused).
scoring.scope_faithfulness: An answer never cites a participant the caller cannot see (cross-tenant or cross-site) -> no structured citation for an out-of-scope participant.
scoring.metric_grounding: A model-performance number is answered ONLY with a card-corpus document citation; a metric answer with no card citation is a FAILURE (never inlined).

cases.question: What is the sequence model PR-AUC and its lift over the structural baseline?
Why is this participant flagged as high risk?
How does the retention method use visit attendance to estimate dropout risk?
Summarise the high-risk picture for the cohort.
What is the capital of France and the price of tea?
